tei:div.tei:p: 505) ༄༅/ tshe bdag stobs chen mchod rten sgrub pa'i ngag 'don khol phyungs bzhugs/ 506) ༄༅/ a+ye a+ye a+ye/ a+ye nyid/ dran par bya: mi 'gyur chos sku'i bdag nyid la: sprul pa'i gzugs sku cir yang snang: kun bzang bha ga gsang ba'i dbyings: rang byung mchod rten chen por/ byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can: mtshan nyid kun tshang bum pa'i dbus: klu 'bum= bcu po rdzogs= gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du: sku sprul 'chi bdag bye ba dang: gsung sprul srog bdag dmar po dang: thugs sprul tshe bdag dbu dgu pa'o: de 'og bang rim dang po'i nang: gshed po= tshar dgu bzhi: de 'og bang rim gsum po la: steng 507) nas rim bzhin mon pa bzhi: bdud bzhi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis rnams: rang rang yum dang bcas pa'o: gdan khri'i phyogs kyi sgo bzhi ru: shar nas rim bzhin rgyal po dang: mgon po bdud dang gnod sbyin bzhi: gzhan yang de dag phyi rol na: pho gshed mo gshed la sogs pa'i: sha za king kang ma mo'i tshogs: sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab: de ltar de dag=

bzlas dmigs ni: lha'i sku dang thugs ka'i yig 'bru las sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros pas yul gang la bya ba rang dbang med par gzir nas srog gi ngo bo'i nang na yod pa'i rnam shes kyi yig 'bru re hur thum 508) dza zhes pas rang dbang med par phrogs/ thugs ka'i rus sbal rngam pa'i khyams nang du e dang ka la bsdus par gyur: bstod pa 'gor: hūm̐: chos dbyings mthing nag ri rab ri yi dbus: mchod rten yongs rdzogs stobs can drag po'i dbus: las kyi tshe bdag gshin rje yongs kyi rje: sbyor yum sgrol yum dbyings yum thabs shes rol: sku gsung thugs sprul dregs pa yongs kyi rje: phyi nang las kyi gshed po yab yum dang: 'chi bdag srog bdag las kyi gshan pa dang: sprul pa yang sprul gshin rje bye ba'i tshogs: ya ma gshin rje'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: srung dang mtshams kyi las mdzod dbyings nas bzhugs: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub bdag la stsol: bstod pa mthar/ ya ma/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skul lo skul lo sems can don la skul: mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i phrin las mdzod: mthing nag gru gsum e yi 509)gzhal yas na: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan: zil gnon yongs rdzogs tshe bdag nag po'i sku: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas pa dkar bas klu brgyad g.yon: g.yon pa dmar bas gnyan khri gsol: dbus mthing rngam pas sa bdag stong: phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na: ye shes 'khor lo rtsibs stong bsnams: bar pa rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams: tha ma ral gris skye shi gcod: g.yon gyi dang pos be con bsnams: bar pa gtun shing dgra sta bsnams: tha ma sdig mdzub zhags pa bsnams: thod skam rigs kyi khro bos brgyan: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal dang ldan: thugs dam dbyings nas drag po'i phrin las mdzod: sbyor ba'i yum mchog badz+ra be ta li:

mthing nag tsit+ta thod khrag gtso la stob: rin chen rus rgyan dur khrod chas dang ldan: sgrol ba'i yum mchog e ka dza ti ma: sku mdog sngo skya mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: gdugs 510) pa sbrul nag 'jigs pa'i ska rags bcings: g.yas pas ral gris skye shing rtsa bar gcod: g.yon pas g.yu spyang spyang mo mgo dgu 'gyed: dbyings yum 'dod pa'i rgyal mo mu kha le: sku mdog dmar nag dud chen 'khyil pa 'dra: sku la rus sbal nag po'i g.yang gzhi gsol: g.yas pas skye 'chi'i khram shing bsnams: g.yon pas nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: yum chen khro mo'i thugs dam skul: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: sku yi sras mchog ya ma ra tsā ni: sku mdog smug nag 'khor lo tsit+ta bsnams: thugs kyi sprul pa phyag na rdo rje ni: sku mdog ljang nag rdo rje 'bar ba bsnams: g.yon pas tsit+ta'i phreng ba bsnams: yon tan khyams gang rus sbal rngam pa ni: mtshon cha'i spu la dug khrag brgyan: sder mo lcags kyu 'bar ba yis: dgra bgegs don snying tshal par gshag: spyi gtsug mkha' lding ga ru ṇa: dung gi sku la g.yu yi mdog: nor bu gnam lcags 511) mchu sder gyis: gdug pa sbrul gyi mgo nas za: sprul pa'i khro rgyal khyung chen bsnams: dbyings nas bskul lo phrin las mdzod: rgyan gyi lha brgyad dregs pa ni: khyung mo smug nag 'khor lo bsnams: seng ge g.yu yi ral pa gsig: stag mo kha nas mi ro za: sbrul gyi kha nas dug rlangs 'phyo: sprul pa sba byed dgra la bh+yo: gnad nas bskul lo phrin las mdzod: mthing nag zla gam gsum gyi dbus: sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ni: tshe bdag srog bdag 'chi bdag gsum: phyag na mtshon cha 'bar ba bsnams: thugs dam bskul lo dgra bgegs sgrol: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gur khang nas: sprul pa'i khro rgyal chen po bcu: rang rang 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas: thugs dam skul lo bar chad sgrol:

bang rim dang po phyogs bzhi nas: ya ma ra tsa myas byed 'bar ba dang: ar+yā dmar po ral pa tshar dgu bzhi: 'khor bcas thugs dam gnad nas bskul: gnod tshe dgra bgegs myur 512) du sgrol: bang rim gnyis pa'i phyogs bzhi ni: dung lcags bse dang gser gyi ni: mon pa bla 'gugs chen po bzhi: skul lo dgra bgegs bla tshe khug: bang rim gsum pa'i phyogs bzhi na: he le khrab pa nag po 'dzum med dang: so 'dar 'khrigs pa ral pa spyir bcings bzhi: thugs dam skul lo dgra gshed mdzod: bang rim bzhi pa'i phyogs mtshams na: be wa sa ta nor bu dge 'phel dang: ser nag 'joms byed bye ba 'bum khri dang: rak+sha glog phreng yak+sha gsod byed dang: gtum po dung khang gang ba kun 'dzoms dang: kha 'bar ral gcig sbrul mgo kun 'dzin dang: ngang pa stobs ldan gyad pa stobs can re: zla ba'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis so: khram bdag yin pas thugs dam skul: dgra bgegs khram la thob la sod: gdan khri chen po'i phyogs bzhi na: bdud po nag po mtshon thogs brgyad: gshen rje be con thogs pa brgyad: ma mo nad rkyal thogs pa brgyad: gnod sbyin ral gri thogs pa brgyad: zhag gi gshin rje so gnyis 513) po: skul lo dgra bgegs khram la thobs: be con 'bar ba mgo la rgyobs: nad kyi rkyal pa dgra la rdobs: ral gri 'bar bas dgra srog chod: sgo bzhir thun bdag chen po bzhi: dkar po snying 'byin mgon po nag po dang: yab rje nag po gnod sbyin sku mchog bzhi: skul lo thugs dam gnas nas skul: lcags kyus zungs la zhags pas chings: lcags sgrog gis sdom dril bus myos: khram la thob la thun khrag rgyobs: srid pa'i 'khor lo bskor la sod: rmog gi phyogs mtshams 'khor yug nas: pho gshed sum brgya drug cu dang: mo gshed sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs: za mar dpang byed gshin rje dang: bdun brgya nyi shu gnad nas skul: sha za drug khri drug stong dang:

khrag 'thung bye ba sa ya dang: gshin rje ma mo sde brgyad dang: snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: bskul lo rbad do mthu ma chung: dgra bgegs khug la myur du sod: ya ya: 'jam dpal zil gnon 'khor dang bcas: 514) dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngags 'chang bdag sdang byed pa'i: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo rnams: gang la bya ba khyed kyis shes: gang la dmigs pa khyod kyis shes: 'di yis sangs rgyas bstan pa gshig: dkon mchog gsum gyi 'phang smad: yi dam la brnyes dmod zing 'tshe: srung ma rnams la mthu med zer: rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra byas: rgyu 'bras bslu med khyad du bsad: rdo rje theg pa dag la 'khu: sngags 'chang bdag la do bsdos pa'i: dgra bo gzugs ling ming byang bu: btab pa 'di dag gar gnas kyang: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: bla srog rnam shes khug la shog: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: don snying rba gyis thogs la shog: snying khrag hub kyis 'thung la= tshangs pa'i gtsug thag chod la= klad khrag zho ltar g.yos la= mgrin pa'i khrag rtsa chod la= khong khrag skyug tu chug la= lte ba'i srid rtsa chod la= lus sems rten dang phrol la= snying gi srog rtsa chod la 515) shog: tshe yi 'du byed 'gums la= srung ma bdud du phob= than dang ltas ngan phos la= nad mtshon drag pos sod la= gri thabs sna dgus sod la= bsad rtags don snying khyer la= zil gnon lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dmigs pa'i dgra bo las ngan 'di'i: sha la rol zhing khrag la 'thung: rus pa mur la tshe srog sdus: rnam shes 'khor ba'i gnas nas drongs: byang chub dam pa 'thob par mdzod: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las drag po 'di: da lta nyid du sgrub par mdzod: thun gtor dgu brlabs nas 'bul/ hūm̐: dmar chen gtor zor gshin rje'i tshogs: sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas: dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du rbad: srid pa g.yo zhing 'khrug byed pa'i:

dmag dpung bskyed la g.yul ngo sprod: dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thul: rjes shul lhag ma med par mdzod: dus la bab po mthu rtsal skyed: smad las skabs/ 516) bla 'gugs sngags dang: e myags mthar/ dgra bgegs ā kar+sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ ā yu dz+nya na ā kar+sha ya hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ ru pa skan+ta ā kar+sha ya hū+ai dzaḥdzaḥ bzla/ hūm̐/ dbye byed las kyi pho nya'i tshogs: las ngan sdig can dgra bo 'di: srung zhing skyob par byed pa yi: ye shes 'jig rten lha yi tshogs: phrol zhig phyes shig rnam par phyes: mnyam por 'ong pa'i bdud dang sprod: e myags mthar/ dgra bgegs dā+e ba ka pa ye e dza la dza laḥ rā dza phye rwa dza phye: a shag shag: ya ma phye ya ma phye ya: spru ta spru ta phus phus: lang lang/ seng seng/ phus phus dgra bgegs yul lha dang phye: srog lha dang phye: pho lha dang phye: mo lha dang phye: bzla/ a+ye ya: thod pa kha sbyor las kyi bshams pa ni: 'jigs rung gtum drag 'bar ba'i lte nang du: dmigs bya mgon med tshud pa las: las gshin dregs pa'i dmag tshogs skar ltar 'khrug: 'khor lo'i rtsibs mtshon gdug pa'i tsha tshwa 'phro: 517)sbal sdig gzugs por mi srun rnam 'gyur can: kun kyang dgra bo'i gshed du cher khros nas: rang gshed 'bebs shing 'gugs 'ching sdom myos gsod: khyad par rang rgyud rtsa ba'i 'khor lo ni: dm-igs bya'i snying gar a yig dbus su ma: de dbus rnam shes ngo bo 'bru gcig po: rtsa bzhi'i dwangs ma zhe sdang sdig pa bzhi'i: mchu la a+ye dun ka yaṃ dmar len mtshon: ru 'dzings e myags 'bru brgyad rtsa brgyad kyi: dwangs ma'i snying por gnas pas gzas pa po'i: chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa brgyad gzung ba gang: lha tshogs thugs ka nas spros sngags 'od kyis: bskul bas sdig pa'i rwa yis rtsa 'dabs brgyad: dum bur bcad de 'byung bzhi rim bzhin du: bsdus mthar rnam shes dwangs ma 'od dkar po'i: rnam pas zil gnon thugs srog dwangs mar thim:

dmigs bya'i gzugs phung gshin rje'i dmag tshogs kyis: rjes med zos te rdul du rlog par gyur: e myags/ mthar/ 518) dgra bo'i srog la hṛ hur thuṃ dza: rtsa khrag tsit+ta thuṃs ril raṃ shag rbad: dgra bo'i tsit+ta breng shag dza: srog la hur thum dzaḥrbadaḥ bzla/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'jam dpal gshin rje yi: pho nyar bsngags pa thun gyi bdag: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la yā: sna tshogs drag po'i thun gyi rdzas: glog ltar 'khyug cing thog ltar 'bebs: dgra bgegs lus sems 'phen la yā: zhes dang dkar po snying 'byin lcags kyus snying nas bzung ste smyo ru bcug par gyur: sngags gsham/ a mu ka e dgra bo'isrog la thum ril rbad bh+yo: mgon po nag pos zhags pas btab nas bzung ste brgyal du bcug par gyur: a mu ka thun khrag shig tsit+ta myong rbad bh+yo: yab rje nag pos lcags sgrog dang khram shing thogs nas dgra bgegs khram la btab par gyur: a mu ka tsa la dun rmugs rbad bh+yo: sku mchog dmar pos zhags pa dang dril bu thogs nas dgra bo'i rtsa rgyud bcad par gyur/ a mu ka ya ma khrag la mugs ti rbad bh+yo: sngags bzhi'i gsham/ 519)sngags pa snying du sodaḥ tsit+ta gtubs rbad longaḥ srog tsit+ta myags myags mā ra ya tsit+ta la thun bh+yoḥ thun gtor la/ hūm̐: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku mdog sngo nag ral pa mun ltar gtibs: sa yi rang bzhin spyi gtsug rtsa la 'jibs: dam nyams sgrol phyir tshangs pa'i gtsug thag chod: dwangs mar bsdus la klad khrag zho ltar 'phyos: 'dod chags khrag mtsho dmar po'i nang shed na: khrag mdog dmar po bse yi ral pa can: chu yi rang bzhin sdig pa bgrad pa'i tshul: dam nyams sgrol phyir mgrin pa'i rtsa chod la: dwangs ma bsdus la khrag ltar skyug tu chugs: nga rgyal keng rus 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku mdog dud kha rngam pa'i zhal gdangs shing: 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rtsa mdud 'joms:

dam nyams sgrol phyir lte ba'i rtsa chod la: dwangs ma bsdus la lus sems bral bar gyis: gti mug dug mtsho khol (520)ma'i nang gshed na: srog bdag nag po ma rung ral pa can: mche ba gtsigs shing dug gsum khongs su 'joms: skye 'gro srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog bsdus: rlung gi rang bzhin dkar nag mtshams na gnas: dam nyams sgrol phyir drag po'i rtsa chod la: dwangs ma bsdus la tshe yi 'du byed khum: gzhan yang 'chi bdag 'khor na gnas pa yi: las kyi gnod sbyin mon mo nag mo bdud: lcags kyu 'bar bas dgra snying khyer la shog: mon pa gsod byed me dang 'khor lo bsnams: gnam lcags mda' dang gdug pa'i khraṃ baṃ thogs: khyi mo dmar mo don snying bla la khyer: bya nag bdun zhi khong nas tsit+ta 'byin: dug sbrul bdun ni khong nas dug mda' rtog: rus sbal bdun ni dgra bo'i tshe srog sdud: sdig pa bdun ni dgra bo'i srog dbugs len: dus la bab po dam rdzas 'di longs la: dam nyams ru tra 'di la rang gshed phobs: ces dang dmar chen gtor zor sogs so/ zhes pa'ang smin lugs sor bzhag la 'bri lugs dang yang cung zad mthur par pad+ma ma ṇis so// dge'o/// /
